item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-147: iPhone Duo inner screen — split root, topic alone in portrait, rotation, fold handoff (legacy part)
item.body:
LOT-147
Refs #237 — this PR is the legacy part only (layout and fold handoff of the iPhone Duo at `87fe0d1c`). Left: the FEAT-016 additions (tab rail when folded, pinned/on-demand sidebar), whose design needs operator approval on #237 first; the Plus tab across a fold (Bookmarks / Alertes Qualitay carry); the cover-screen thumb actions and their detection (GAP-713, `PhoneDisplayPolicy`, `CoverScreenThumbActions`).
Claim: mac/M1
Author model: Claude Opus 5.5 (mac/M1-l147-opus)
Reviewer model: Fable 5.1 (mac/M1-l147-fable-review)

### Problem
The unfolded iPhone Duo (a `.phone` that reports regular width and regular height) showed the tab bar with stretched iPhone stacks. The rotation setting also locked it. Legacy at the reference gives it the split root (sidebar, list and topic), shows the topic full width in portrait, does not lock its rotation, and keeps the topic read across a fold or an unfold (GAP-210, GAP-213, GAP-215, GAP-217).

### Cause
`RootNavigationView.usesSidebarRoot` was the `2440d79` rule (`idiom == .pad && regular width`). `OrientationPolicy` had no unfolded case.

### What changed, and why this wide
- `RootNavigationView.usesSidebarRoot(idiom:horizontal:vertical:)`: the legacy rule (`MainWindow.swift:1380-1388` @ 87fe0d1c). The root switch moves into `RootLayout` so a hosted test can drive it over a given `RootModel`. Its `rootLayoutIdiom` override lets the test pin the idiom.
- `RootSidebarView` + `DuoSplitColumns`: legacy `prefersDetailOnlyTopic`. On a `.phone` in portrait, an open topic takes the whole width. Landscape, or no topic, brings the list back. Every other case keeps the user's choice. The list-back half applies to the iPad too, as legacy's `ensureVisibleIPadListIfNeeded` (`:2281-2290`): an iPad whose user hid the columns gets list and topic back when the topic goes. The orientation is measured in `RootLayout`, which outlives a fold, and seeds the split's visibility, so an unfold in portrait with a topic open starts with the topic alone.
- Fold handoff: both roots already read one `RootModel` (LOT-170), so the topic and its reader/page carry over. A collapsed tab split with its topic selected shows the reader by itself, measured for Favoris, Catégories (three columns) and Messages; an explicit start column was tried and dropped. `RootModel.rootSwapped()` closes the readers that links pushed, because legacy carries only the root reader. This also applies to an iPad window crossing regular width (Slide Over), as in legacy. Intentional difference: each tab keeps its own topic, not only the selected tab's (see spec).
- `OrientationPolicy`: unfolded → `.allButUpsideDown` whatever `landscape_mode`; `refresh()` does not ask an unfolded scene to rotate; a height-class change (fold) refreshes it (`Common.swift:187-200, 216-242`).
- Spec: legacy counterpart, behaviour, differences, and what is left.
Not touched: the FEAT-016 design, the cover-screen thumb actions, inline titles (#681: no hang), the Plus carry.

### Tests
All on the `agent-147 iPhone Duo` simulator (iOS 27.2).
- `DuoLayoutTests` (new, pure rules): `aPhoneRegularInBothDimensionsGetsTheSplitRoot`, `theCoverScreenAndALandscapeProMaxKeepTheTabBar`, `anIPadKeepsItsRegularWidthRule`; `theUnfoldedDuoRotatesWhateverTheSetting`, `theStoredLockDoesNotApplyUnfolded`, `onlyRegularInBothDimensionsIsExpanded`; `onlyAPhoneInPortraitPrefersTheTopicAlone`, `aTopicOpenedInPortraitTakesTheFullWidth`, `landscapeOrNoTopicShowsTheListAgain`, `otherChangesKeepTheUsersChoice`.
- `DuoLayoutHostedTests` (new, the real `RootLayout` over fakes, the idiom pinned to `.phone`, the size classes changed live to stand in for the fold):
  - `theUnfoldedDuoShowsTheSplitThenTheTopicAlone`: split root and no tab bar; a selected topic gives `displayMode == .secondaryOnly`.
  - `aFoldAndAnUnfoldKeepTheTopicAndItsPage`: the reader moved to page 3, fold → tab bar with "Sujet 1 p3", the linked "p4" reader closed, the same reader model; unfold → split with "Sujet 1 p3".
  - `aTopicClosedOnTheCoverScreenDoesNotComeBackUnfolded`: back on the cover clears the selection; unfold shows no topic.
  - `aFoldShowsTheTopicOpenInTheTab(tab:)` (round 1): Catégories (forum + topic) and Messages (a conversation) show their reader on the cover after a fold.
  - `anUnfoldShowsTheTopicAloneFromTheFirstFrame` (round 1): the first display mode the unfolded split shows is `.secondaryOnly`.
- `PagerPlacementTests`: moved to the new signature, plus `unfoldedDuoHasNoTabBar`.
- **Fail without the change** (mutation runs, logs in the work folder):
  - A, the old root rule and no unfolded orientation case: 7 tests fail (both pure root tests, the pager one, both orientation tests, all 3 hosted ones).
  - B, `rootSwapped` a no-op and no topic-alone rule: `aFoldAndAnUnfoldKeepTheTopicAndItsPage` fails (the "p4" reader is carried), `aTopicOpenedInPortraitTakesTheFullWidth` and `theUnfoldedDuoShowsTheSplitThenTheTopicAlone` fail.
  - R1 (round 1: the split's visibility not seeded; `rootSwapped` clearing Catégories and Messages and reopening Favoris at its row's page): `anUnfoldShowsTheTopicAloneFromTheFirstFrame`, both `aFoldShowsTheTopicOpenInTheTab` cases and `aFoldAndAnUnfoldKeepTheTopicAndItsPage` (page 3 lost) fail. For Messages, R1 is red before the fold (the mutated `rootSwapped` clears the selection when the host's first size classes arrive), so it proves the green path only, not the fold path (Fable round 2, Low 1). Known difference (Fable round 2, detail 2): the Plus id is topic-stable, like legacy's `TopicNavigationID`, so another bookmark or alert of the same topic does not take the topic alone again in portrait; recorded on #237.
- Touched suites green (plus `RegularWidthListStyleTests`): `TabSplitWidthTests`, `SidebarDetailHostedTests`, `OrientationPolicyTests`.
- Whole `SwiftHFRTests` target (round 1 head): 2049 tests in 264 suites on the iPhone Duo simulator: 5 fail, with 10 issues (`ListDensityMarginsTests` landscape margins, `ReaderUnderBarsTests.inANavigationStackTheTopBarAndTheBottomBarReachThePage`, `AccountMenuPlacementTests.probeSeesNothingOnTheLeft…`, `FavoritesUnreadFilterTests.theButtonIsInTheBar…`, `ComposerLayoutHostedTests.theCardAndTheFloatingButtons…`). The same 5 tests fail with the same 10 issues at `origin/dev-swift` 12fdd8bf on the same simulator (a baseline run of those suites): this is how the Duo simulator behaves, not caused by this PR. CI runs them on its iPhone simulator.
- Screenshots: the unfolded inner screen cannot be shown (the simulator boots folded; its inner display renders black), so only the cover screen and the iPad were captured, after the change; both show the first-launch « Import de HFR+ » sheet over an unchanged root.

### Device check (operator, physical Duo or Xcode DeviceHub — the simulator cannot fold unattended; listed on #893, does not block the merge)
1. Unfold: the sidebar + list + topic appear. In portrait, opening a topic shows it alone. Rotating to landscape shows list + topic again.
2. With `Rotation` locked in Réglages: the unfolded Duo still rotates. Fold in landscape: the cover screen returns to portrait.
3. Read a topic on page N on the cover, unfold: same topic, page N, in the detail column. Follow a link (pushed reader), fold: the root topic shows, not the linked one.
4. Close the topic on the cover (back), unfold: no topic comes back.
5. iPad: three columns at launch; with the columns hidden, closing the topic brings list and topic back; Slide Over → tab bar keeps the topic (readers pushed by links are closed, as legacy).

### Ledger
```gap-edit
GAP-210
SwiftHFR final: The `2fe43da3` condition: an iPad at regular width or any scene regular in both dimensions (the unfolded iPhone Duo) gets the split root; a landscape Pro Max and the cover screen keep the tab bar; one selection shared by both layouts (LOT-170, LOT-147).
```

```gap-edit
GAP-213
SwiftHFR final: Same policy, applied live; the unfolded Duo rotates whatever the setting and is not asked to rotate, the lock applies again once folded (LOT-147). Portrait lock while composing not ported yet.
```

```gap-edit
GAP-215
SwiftHFR final: As legacy at `2fe43da3`: split root unfolded, topic full width in portrait once chosen, list and topic in landscape, fold handoff (GAP-217) (LOT-147). The FEAT-016 additions are GAP-655.
```

```gap-edit
GAP-217
SwiftHFR final: Topic and page kept across fold and unfold through the one root model both layouts read (not the scroll position); the readers a link pushed are closed; every tab keeps its own topic, not only the selected one (LOT-147). The Plus tab (Bookmarks, Alertes Qualitay) is not carried yet.
Gap: ported with changes
```

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, mac/M1-l147-fable-review, ad6e87e6)** — **REQUEST CHANGES**

1. **Medium** — `docs/lots/LOT-147-duo-ipad-columns.md:85`, `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootTabsView.swift` / `App/SwiftHFR/Messages/MessagesRootView.swift` (commit ad6e87e6). The spec says a tab split with a topic open "shows the reader (the collapsed split's own behaviour, measured by `DuoLayoutHostedTests`)"; only Favoris was measured (mutC), yet the explicit start column (`compactStart`) was removed from Catégories (three-column collapsed split, two selections) and Messages on that one run. Scenario: Messages conversation or Catégories topic open, fold → the cover shows the list, the topic stays selected but not shown; no test catches it. Fix: a hosted fold case per tab (or keep `compactStart` there), and say what was measured (L08).
2. **Low** — `App/SwiftHFRTests/Root/DuoLayoutTests.swift:611-634`: "keeps its page" is asserted on page 1, which is also the reader's `requested` target; a swap that reloaded the requested target would stay green. Move the reader to page 3 before folding and assert "Sujet 1 p3".
3. **Low** — `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootSidebarView.swift:16-18`: each unfold starts with `isPortrait = false`, `visibility = .all`; the first frame shows three columns before `.detailOnly` (legacy's `isPortraitLayout` is root state that survives the swap, `MainWindow.swift:1361`). Seed the flag from the geometry or pass it from `RootLayout`.
4. **Low** (L08) — PR body "so the iPad is unchanged": `DuoSplitColumns.visibility` (`.detailOnly → .doubleColumn` when the topic goes, and the shared `visibility` state of no-list Plus entries) applies to the iPad too (legacy `ensureVisibleIPadListIfNeeded`, `:2281-2290`). State it in the spec.
5. **Detail** — `App/SwiftHFR/Root/RootModel.swift:49`: the `.plus` id is an `ObjectIdentifier` string (address reuse after dealloc); use the reader's target. `Reviewer model:` still pending in the body; the device check belongs on #893 (AGENTS §7), not only in the PR.

**Verified**: diff vs `origin/dev-swift` (merge-base 12fdd8bf); every legacy citation at 87fe0d1c and 2fe43da3 (`usesSidebarRoot` :1380-1388 / :1357-1365, `prefersDetailOnlyTopic` :1390-1396, handlers :1729-1762, `rootContainer` :1792-1799, `activeTopicTarget` :2093-2108, `handleRootSwap` :2140-2193, :2128-2135, :2215-2217, :2281-2290, `Common.swift:187-242`, `MessagesView.swift:3245-3272`, FoldHandoff files) says what is claimed; `python3 -I tooling/docs/ledger.py check-body --file` → 4 blocks ok; mutation logs: mutA red on 7 tests (both root rules, pager, both orientation, 3 hosted), mutB red on 3, mutC green; `base-test.log` and `full-test.log` (2047 tests, after the last commit) share the same 5 failing tests / 10 issues (pre-existing on the Duo simulator); no line > 140 in the changed files, swiftlint not installed locally (CI `--strict` is the arbiter); `RootTabsView.swift` and `MessagesRootView.swift` byte-identical to base; `rootLayoutIdiom` is nil in production.

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1, mac/M1-l147-fable-review, 95afae4b, round 2 delta)** — **APPROVE**

Round 1: all five findings fixed (fold measured per tab, page 3 kept, split seeded from `RootLayout.isPortrait`, iPad wording in spec and doc comment, `.plus` id no longer an address, `Reviewer model:` line). The seeding self-corrects when the orientation and the size classes arrive in either order (`onChange(of: detailLayout)` turns a stale seed into `.detailOnly` or `.doubleColumn`).

1. **Low** (L08) — PR body "R1 … both `aFoldShowsTheTopicOpenInTheTab` cases fail": for Messages the run is red at `DuoLayoutTests.swift:294`, before the fold (the mutated `rootSwapped` cleared `messages.selected` when the host's first size classes flipped `usesSidebarRoot`), so `:298` is a consequence, not evidence for the fold path. The green assertion is sound (`shows` reads the top title of a navigation controller whose view is in the window; a collapsed split starting on its list shows the list's title). Fix: run a Messages-only mutation (pin the collapsed split's compact column to the list in `MessagesRootView`), expected red at `:298` only, or say in the body what R1 proves for Messages.
2. **Detail** — `RootModel.swift:261`: the `.plus` id is topic-stable, like legacy's `TopicNavigationID` (`Common.swift:2885-2925`), and `.source` is right (`requested` changes on each page load, `TopicReaderModel.swift:529`). Consequence: in portrait with the columns shown back, another bookmark or alert of the same topic no longer takes the topic alone (the `ObjectIdentifier` did; legacy `selectTopic`, `:2213-2217`, does on every selection); the tab lists share it. Note it in the spec's "keeps the user's choice", no code change needed.
3. **Detail** — body says the device check is "listed on #893": the only "1115" on #893 is an orchestrator note about #1120. List it before the merge.

**Verified**: `git diff ad6e87e6 95afae4b` in full; legacy `:1361`, `:1672-1676`, `:1750-1762`, `:2093-2108`, `:2213-2217`, `:2281-2290` @ 87fe0d1c say what is cited; `ledger.py check-body`: 4 blocks ok; `mutR1.out`: 4 tests red, 8 issues; `full2-test.log`: 2049 tests, 264 suites, 10 issues on the same 5 tests as the 12fdd8bf baseline; no line > 140 in the four changed Swift files; the two other `RootSidebarView` callers use the default `detailOnlyTopic`. No build or test run (read-only delta).
